title: Strengthen the crash-restart drill: real dispatch after the restart, and the restart-notice variant per session
outcome: The crash-restart drill shows through the real dispatch path that a prompt sent after a crash restart is not queued behind the interrupted turn. It also asserts which restart notice each session gets: 'waiting for approval or input' plus '1 queued prompt remains saved.' for the Approval session, and 'before this turn finished' for the Active one.
acceptance: Strengthen the crash-restart drill: real dispatch after the restart, and the restart-notice variant per session is done
